  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde;
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto.

title: Director of Paid Media
description:
ABOUT MYMAGICHEALER

MyMagicHealer is a growing e comm natural skin healing brand, serving customers with HS, acne, eczema, and chronic skin conditions who trust us for relief, results, and hope.


We are building the #1 skin healing company in North America— and we’re looking for a Director of Paid Media to lead our performance engine.


ROLE OVERVIEW

We are hiring a Director of Paid Media (Hands-On) who will OWN the entire paid acquisition engine — strategy, execution, creative testing, and scaling.

This role is responsible for:

  • Daily Meta Ads execution
  • Scaling profitably
  • Creative testing system
  • Performance strategy
  • Funnel & CRO improvements
  • Growth forecasting
  • Cross-team leadership


You are a hybrid operator:

50% hands-on media buyer

50% strategic growth leader

This role is critical to reach our $20M–$50M scale.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Paid Media Execution (Hands-On)

  • Run Meta Ads daily (scaling, testing, optimization)
  • Manage budgets from $7k/day → 20K/day

Own CAC, ROAS, MER targets

Maintain daily performance guardrails

Build and execute creative tests

Launch structured A/B tests

Adjust spend based on forecasting + inventory 


2. Overseeing Creative Strategy

Develop hooks, angles, and ad concepts

Analyze winning creative patterns

Lead weekly “Creative Performance Review”

Ensure weekly creative testing velocity


3. Growth Strategy & Forecasting

Build weekly & monthly growth plans

Forecast CAC/MER and revenue based on spend

Maintain KPI dashboards

Present weekly growth performance to CEO

Partner with Ops on inventory and cashflow to inform scaling

Plan budget allocation across channels


4. Funnel & CRO Optimization

Audit landing pages & identify conversion opportunities

Recommend split tests & improvements

Collaborate with CRO/Designer on LPs, PDPs, and offer pages

Improve checkout conversion and reduce friction

Align offers & bundles for paid efficiency


5. Cross-Functional Leadership

Collaborate with Content Director

Work closely with creative team, and editors

Lead weekly Growth Meeting

Build SOPs for scaling, testing, reporting


KPIs YOU OWN

  • MER (daily, weekly, monthly)
  • CAC vs Target
  • ROAS by funnel stage
  • Creative testing velocity
  • % of revenue from paid
  • New customer acquisition volume
  • Profit per order after ads
  • Scaling efficiency (margins)


REQUIREMENTS

  • 4–8+ years in performance marketing (e-commerce)
  • Experience managing $100k–$1M+ monthly ad spend
  • Expert-level Meta Ads experience (mandatory)
  • Bonus: TikTok Ads + Google Ads
  • Experience with UGC-driven direct-response creative
  • Previous leadership experience
  • Proficiency in Google suite


Skills:

  • Deep understanding of CAC, MER, ROAS, cohorts, and blended metrics
  • Strong funnel & CRO understanding
  • Strong creative strategy instincts
  • Highly analytical (Excel/Sheets fluency)
  • Strong communication & leadership
  • Ability to build systems, SOPs, and improve processes
  • High accountability and ownership mentality
  • Iteration-driven
  • Problem solver
  • Calm under pressure
  • Strategic & data-led
  • Obsessed with performance
  • Self-starter, proactive, independent
  • Loves speed + excellence
  • Loves building and scaling systems


WHY JOIN MYMAGICHEALER

Fast-growing, profitable DTC brand with strong community

Founder-led, vision-driven company

Creative freedom + huge impact

You directly influence how we scale from $10M → $50M

Performance bonus

Paid time off

Health Spending Account (if in Canada)

description:
Ganhe de R$3.000 a R$7.000!


️ Missão

Assegurar a retenção dos clientes, garantindo o máximo retorno sobre seus investimentos em marketing digital, construindo cases de sucesso através de uma estratégia integrada (que não se limita a Tráfego Pago), inovação (que busca novas soluções, técnicas e ferramentas), excelência no atendimento ao cliente e da liderança técnica do time de gestores de tráfego.

  • Implementar práticas de inovação contínua: testes, novas ferramentas, automações e inteligência artificial.
  • Promover cultura de excelência e foco em ROI dentro da equipe.

title: Analista de QA e Testes - Pleno - Remoto
description:
Essa é uma vaga remota

Como Analista de QA e Testes Pleno na Supera, você será responsável por garantir a qualidade de sistemas críticos distribuídos, atuando com autonomia na definição de estratégias de teste e contribuindo tecnicamente para a confiabilidade dos produtos.

Sua missão: assegurar que o software entregue seja estável, seguro e escalável através de testes manuais e automatizados; antecipar riscos de qualidade; participar de decisões técnicas relacionadas à testabilidade e observabilidade; garantir que os produtos dos nossos clientes operem com qualidade de nível de produção.

title: Local SEO Specialist
description:
About Service Scalers

At Service Scalers, we’re on a mission to help local service pros, like plumbers, electricians, and HVAC experts, grow their businesses without the stress. Our team specializes in local SEO that actually works; helping our clients show up where it matters most, get more calls, and grow their customer base.


At Service Scalers, every team member plays a key role in shaping the future of how local service businesses grow online - and we’re just getting started.


Enough about us, we want to talk about you!

We’re looking for a skilled and experienced Local SEO Specialist (Google Business Profile Focus) to join our team and help our clients achieve top local rankings. If you are passionate about local SEO, have a keen eye for detail, and thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you!


Responsibilities

Full GBP Listing Optimization including:

  • Description writing
  • Service category optimization
  • Service area optimization
  • Products and offers management
  • FAQ publication
  • NAP consistency checks
  • Citation management
  • Sourcing of imagery
  • Weekly internal reporting
  • Monthly client reporting


What You’ll Need

  • A computer or laptop and wifi
  • Proven experience in GBP page optimization and local SEO strategies
  • Strong understanding of local search ranking factors and algorithms
  • Proficient in using GBP and local SEO tools
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines


What’s in it for you

  • Amazing culture with amazing people (of course we would say this, but come see for yourself).
  • We have a work-hard, play-hard mentality mixed with a strong sense of community.
  • Fully remote position
  • Unlimited vacation days
  • Up to USD $30k depending on experience

title: Localization Ops Consultant
description:
Localization Operations Consultant (Brazil Market focus)

● Fully remote role.

● Currently based in China, Brazil or United States.

● Work on a project basis, responding to requests as needed.


About the Role:

We are seeking consultants with deep, first-hand knowledge of Brazilian culture to help us adapt our products and marketing for local users. This is a flexible, project-based role designed for individuals who understand the everyday Brazilian perspective.


Primary Responsibilities:

1. Provide Local User Perspective: Review and give feedback on product aesthetics and appeal from the viewpoint of a typical Brazilian consumer. Professional design experience is not required—we value an authentic, ground-level sense of what resonates locally.

2. Support Local Research: Assist with market research initiatives in Brazil. Ideal candidates can also help source and connect us with relevant local participants for surveys or interviews.

3. Offer On-the-Ground Insights: Help verify product localization and provide context on local trends, festivals, holidays, and social conversations in Brazil.


Core Requirements:

● Active user of photo/video editing applications.

● Possess native-level understanding of Brazilian culture, ideally through long-term residence or formative life experience in Brazil.

● Language Proficiency: Native or fluent speaker of Portuguese. Professional working proficiency in English or Mandarin Chinese is required.

● Responsible, reliable, and committed to delivering high-quality, thoughtful feedback.

● Active user of major social media platforms, particularly TikTok and Instagram.


Nice-to-Have:

● Prior experience in consumer app operations or marketing focused on the Brazilian market.

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
Junior Recruiter (fully remote)

We are an American recruiting company with more than 30 years of success in the US recruiting market. As the IT market keeps growing, we are looking to expand our talented international team of Recruiters.


What you’ll do

This is a communication-driven role. Your typical day includes:

  • Proactive calling to identify qualified candidates among the ones selected by our sourcing team
  • Interviewing candidates and preparing their documents
  • Coaching candidates before interviews with our clients
  • Conducting follow-ups after interviews
  • Extending job offers and supporting candidates through the offer process


What you need

  •  Upper-Intermediate English or higher
  • Good communication skills. Most of your day is going to be spent communicating: the better you can demonstrate your ability to listen, explain different roles and negotiate, the better results you will get
  • Self-motivation and the ability to stay consistent in a remote environment
  • Goal-oriented mindset - you like measurable achievements
  • Availability to work Monday through Friday, from 10 am to 7 pm Brazil time (8 hours of work with a 1-hour break)
  • Personal laptop or PC (corporate laptop provided after 6 months)


What you’ll get

  • Base salary + performance-based commissions (no caps)
  • Remote job in your comfortable place
  • Paid, hands-on training from day one
  • Internet reimbursement
  • Ongoing online training programs and paid seminars/webinars
  • Corporate wellness program (gym membership, massage therapy, etc.)
  • Benefits package (paid vacation, holidays, sick time off, parental leave)


Find out more about us:


We hope to see you soon!

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
Junior Recruiter (fully remote)

We are an American recruiting company with more than 30 years of success in the US recruiting market. As the IT market keeps growing, we are looking to expand our talented international team of Recruiters.


What you’ll do

This is a communication-driven role. Your typical day includes:

  • Proactive calling to identify qualified candidates among the ones selected by our sourcing team
  • Interviewing candidates and preparing their documents
  • Coaching candidates before interviews with our clients
  • Conducting follow-ups after interviews
  • Extending job offers and supporting candidates through the offer process


What you need

  •  Upper-Intermediate English or higher
  • Good communication skills. Most of your day is going to be spent communicating: the better you can demonstrate your ability to listen, explain different roles and negotiate, the better results you will get
  • Self-motivation and the ability to stay consistent in a remote environment
  • Goal-oriented mindset - you like measurable achievements
  • Availability to work Monday through Friday, from 10 am to 7 pm Brazil time (8 hours of work with a 1-hour break)
  • Personal laptop or PC (corporate laptop provided after 6 months)

  • Base salary + performance-based commissions (no caps)
  • Remote job in your comfortable place
  • Paid, hands-on training from day one

  • Ongoing online training programs and paid seminars/webinars

title: Especialista em Anúncios (Nível Inicial)
description:
Resumo da Vaga

Estamos buscando um Executivo de Anúncios / Especialista em Anúncios motivado para se juntar à nossa equipe de marketing digital. Nesta função, você auxiliará no planejamento, lançamento e otimização de campanhas publicitárias em plataformas como Google Ads e Facebook Ads. Esta posição oferece experiência prática valiosa e a oportunidade de apoiar campanhas de alto impacto que visam impulsionar o reconhecimento da marca, o tráfego do website, a geração de leads e conversões.


Principais Responsabilidades


Auxiliar na configuração e no gerenciamento de campanhas de publicidade paga no Google Ads e Facebook Ads (incluindo pesquisa de palavras-chave, criação de anúncios, segmentação e estratégias de lances).


Monitorar métricas de campanha, como CPC, CTR, CPA e ROAS, e sugerir otimizações básicas.


Colaborar com as equipes de conteúdo e design para desenvolver materiais criativos para anúncios (texto, elementos visuais, vídeos curtos).


Auxiliar em testes A/B de textos publicitários, elementos visuais e landing pages para melhorar o desempenho.


Preparar e compartilhar relatórios de desempenho regulares para monitorar a saúde da campanha e destacar insights.


Requisitos

title: MSP Delivery Specialist (Trilingual English | Spanish | Portuguese)
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a trusted leader in workforce solutions and managed service provider (MSP) operations. We partner with enterprise clients to streamline contingent workforce management, strengthen supplier relationships, and ensure program compliance. Our mission is to deliver operational excellence through technology-driven solutions, industry expertise, and exceptional service quality across all facets of workforce delivery.


Summary

Pinnacle Group is seeking an MSP Delivery Specialist to manage the full life cycle of contingent workforce requests. This role serves as a key point of contact for client hiring managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring seamless requisition management, compliance, and operational success. The ideal candidate has strong experience in recruitment, MSP operations, and Vendor Management Systems (VMS), combined with a customer service mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.


Job Description

  • Train, assist, and facilitate the requisition life cycle with client hiring managers and suppliers.
  • Support large-scale hiring initiatives, VMS data integrity projects, and supplier rationalization efforts.
  • Conduct intake calls, qualify candidate resumes, and manage requisition flow from posting through fulfillment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers, suppliers, and internal program teams to ensure program success.
  • Maintain a service-focused approach, delivering a high-quality experience to all stakeholders.
  • Utilize and provide training on MSP tools such as Beeline or SAP Fieldglass, and applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of required documentation by suppliers, maintaining adherence to SLAs and KPIs.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and client-specific initiatives as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, preferably in a business-related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in recruiting, MSP operations, or contingent workforce management.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and familiarity with VMS tools (Beeline, Fieldglass, or similar).
  • Trilingual Competency across English, Spanish and Portuguese
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly.
  • Proven success in a client-facing, fast-paced, and service-oriented environment.
  • Self-starter who can work independently and exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities with a solution-driven mindset.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you’ll play a vital role in advancing workforce solutions that power some of the world’s leading organizations. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your MSP expertise, build strategic relationships, and make a meaningful impact in a company that values excellence and accountability.


Compensation and Benefits Disclosure

The specific compensation for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Our full-time consultants have access to benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401K contributions as well as any other PTO, sick leave, and other benefits mandated by appliable state or localities where you reside or work.

title: Founding Full Stack Engineer
description:
Company Description

ContractPower is an AI-powered document intelligence platform designed to streamline contract review, regulatory compliance, and obligation tracking for the renewable energy and infrastructure sectors. By leveraging advanced AI capabilities, ContractPower identifies and extracts key compliance items, summarizes complex documents, and cross-references project documents with energy tariffs. Our platform enables energy professionals to save significant time and reduce risks while effectively managing interconnection agreements, PPAs, and more. Trusted by leading developers and backed by Techstars, ContractPower is transforming how the renewable energy industry handles complex agreements.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Founding Full Stack Engineer at ContractPower. The engineer will be responsible for building, deploying, and optimizing our platform using both front-end and back-end technologies, contributing to the entire software development lifecycle. Day-to-day tasks include designing, coding, debugging, and maintaining scalable web-based applications, while collaborating with team members to deliver a seamless user experience. This role also involves problem-solving, improving system performance, and implementing innovative features for energy professionals.


Qualifications

  • Expertise in Back-End Web Development and Full-Stack Development
  • Proficiency in frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Vue) and backend languages (e.g., Node.js, Python)
  • Experience in Software Development, including building and optimizing web applications
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic, remote-first environment
  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Familiarity with renewable energy or infrastructure sectors is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field is preferred

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Must-haves:

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • AWS Experience – EC2, Security Groups, Command Line usage
  • Terraform Experience – Command line and coding experience to stand up cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update permissions on security groups (following existing formats)
  • Linux Environment – Experience with Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & Automation – Ability to write scripts for deployment using Packer or Terraform


Day-to-Day:

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products. Responsibilities include managing permissions, handling one-off requests via Slack, resolving access issues, and supporting releases for new services. You’ll be responsible for patching and maintaining cloud infrastructure, primarily in a Linux environment. You’ll use AWS (EC2, Security Groups) and Terraform to manage infrastructure as code, following established formats. Tasks also include scripting for deployment and collaborating with engineering teams to ensure smooth operations. Some exposure to Windows environments is acceptable, though the focus is on Amazon Linux.


Benefits Information – CLT

This is a CLT opportunity. You are eligible for 15 days annual holidays/sick time and 30 days annual time off. Benefits also include an FTGS contribution, social security contribution, and a meal voucher. Annual salary will be paid in local currency (REAL), and ranges based on years of experience and skillset. Full details on time off listed below. Medical/healthcare is NOT provided due to the public healthcare system.

EOR (CLT) in Brazil have all the statutory benefits:

  • Meal Voucher
  • Social Security
  • Workers Compensation Insurance
  • State Pension Fund


Paid Time Off

Both full-time and part-time employees are entitled to 30 calendar days of paid time off (PTO) a year. PTO accrues monthly at 2.5 days per month. Employees are eligible for annual leave after 1 year of work. During the first year of employment, an employee is not allowed to take any leave.

title: UI/Motion Front-End Developer English C1/C2 - PART TIME
description:
Position: UI/Motion Front-End Developer

Type: Part-Time (remote)

Location: LATAM / Global (must have good overlap with EST)

English: C1/C2 preferred

About the Role


We’re looking for a highly skilled Front-End/UI Developer with a strong focus on motion and animation to collaborate with a U.S. digital product team.

This role is ideal for someone who loves bringing interfaces to life with smooth transitions, polished interactions, and visually engaging motion design.


What You’ll Work On


  • Building high-quality UI experiences
  • Creating smooth micro-interactions, transitions, and motion effects
  • Collaborating closely with designers and the engineering team
  • Implementing animations where needed (GSAP, Rive, or similar tools)
  • Working with modern front-end workflows and component-based architectures
Required Skills


  • Strong experience with JavaScript
  • Advanced proficiency in Tailwind CSS
  • Experience in UI motion / animations
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in English (C1/C2)
Nice-to-Have Skills (Not Mandatory)


  • GSAP
  • Rive
  • Astro
  • Experience with transitions, motion systems, interaction patterns
  • Strong visual/UI polish
Who We’re Looking For


A developer who is:


  • Detail-oriented with a strong aesthetic sense
  • Passionate about motion and front-end craft
  • Comfortable working remotely and communicating proactively
  • Available for part-time collaboration with good EST overlap

title: Promotor e Assistente de Negócios - Lajeado/RS | Sicredi Integração RSMG
description:
Quer fazer parte de uma instituição que valoriza o cuidado com as pessoas, fortalece vínculos e gera impacto positivo nas regiões onde está presente? essa é a sua oportunidade! ✨

Estamos com vagas abertas para atuar como Promotor e Assistente de Negócios em diversas áreas e agências na nossa região de atuação – Lajeado e arredores .

Se você busca um ambiente colaborativo , com desenvolvimento contínuo e impacto positivo na comunidade , essa é a sua chance!


Vamos juntos construir ambientes de confiança, desenvolvimento e pertencimento.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Promotor de Negócios: Apoiar a área de negócios da agência no atendimento aos associados e clientes, prestando informações relacionadas aos produtos e serviços do Sicredi Realizar atividades operacionais no autoatendimento visando um atendimento ágil e eficiente e a efetivação de negócios e cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.


Principais responsabilidades:

✔Executar tarefas rotineiras de suporte e atendimento ao negócio e/ou suporte administrativo;

✔Realizar atendimento aos associados, contribuindo com a efetividade e fomento dos negócios;

✔Apoiar na formalização das operações, recebendo e conferindo documentos conforme as formalidades legais;

✔Preparar rotinas para garantir um atendimento mais ágil e eficiente às demandas dos associados.


Assistente de Negócios: Realizar atendimento aos associados, auxiliar o Gerente de Negócios, contribuir com a efetividade e fomento dos negócios. Apoiar na formalísticas das operações, receber documentos e ser responsável pela conferência, checando o cumprimento das formalidades legais das operações. Preparar as rotinas para um atendimento mais ágil e eficiente nas demandas dos associados.


Principais responsabilidades:

✔Apoiar os Gerentes de Negócios no atendimento aos associados, prestando informações sobre produtos e serviços do Sicredi;

✔Realizar atividades operacionais e de apoio ao autoatendimento, visando agilidade e efetivação de negócios;

✔Orientar os associados sobre o uso dos canais de autoatendimento;

✔Direcionar os associados conforme suas necessidades (plataforma de negócios ou guichês de caixa);

✔Identificar oportunidades e fomentar novos negócios, apresentando soluções financeiras adequadas.


Requisitos e qualificações:

✔Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia, Gestão Comercial, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas afins ;

✔ Experiência desejável em atividades financeiras, administrativas, comerciais ou de suporte ao negócio;

✔ Vivência com atendimento ao público será um diferencial;

✔ Habilidades de relacionamento, negociação e vendas;

✔ Conhecimento sobre produtos e serviços financeiros;

✔ CPA-10 obrigatório (CPA-20 será um diferencial);

✔ Perfil proativo, comunicativo e curioso, com vontade de aprender e crescer;

✔ Disponibilidade para viagens e residência preferencial em Lajeado ou região.

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

description:
Azure | Terraform | Microsoft Entra ID | Github | Python | PostgreSQL | Networking | B2B


At Vertex Agility , we partner with the world’s most ambitious enterprises to deliver transformation that matters — across cloud, AI, cybersecurity, and digital identity .


We’re now looking for a Azure Devops Engineer to join a multicultural team building the next generation of — driving innovation at scale and redefining how digital platforms.


What You’ll Do

Ready to help define the future of secure innovation?


Apply now →

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


1. Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of

our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance,

reliability, and scalability.

2. Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and

support business processes

3. API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal

and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare

systems and third-party services.

4. Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare

industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining

robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


1. Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in

backend development, code review, and team collaboration.

2. Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to

continually innovate and enhance the platform.

3. Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint

planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of

high-quality software.

4. Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface

and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end

functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies/Requirements:


1. Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL.

Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.

2. Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a

proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web

applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is

highly desirable.

3. Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think

analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

4. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills,

capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and

stakeholders.

5. Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design

specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and

efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth


Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Software Engineer Full Stack Pleno (Foco Front-end)
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões de rodada em investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.

A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. Em um setor que se transforma todos os dias, somos reconhecidos por liderar essa mudança com visão estratégica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver interfaces de usuário modernas e responsivas e participar ativamente da implementação de soluções escaláveis e resilientes;
  • Trabalhar transversalmente com squads, garantindo boas práticas de engenharia e decisões consistentes com a visão de longo prazo da plataforma;
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, design de sistemas, arquitetura e iniciativas de refatoração estratégica;
  • Colaborar com áreas de produto e negócios para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Garantir excelência na experiência do usuário e performance front-end;
  • Conduzir iniciativas de inovação tecnológica, incluindo POCs e adoção de novas ferramentas ou paradigmas.


Competências:

  • Experiência com stacks como: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Node.js (NestJS), PostgreSQL..
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes altamente regulados ou em fintechs / agtechs / software as a service (saas);
  • Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas ou iniciativas open source;
  • Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e design de arquitetura de serviços e dados;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenharia;
  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (4+ anos), com histórico de impacto técnico significativo;
  • Experiência com Angular e desenvolvimento de SPAs (Single Page Applications);
  • Experiência com APIs REST;
  • Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP), automação de infraestrutura (IaC), CI/CD e observabilidade;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL) e não relacionais em alta escala;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento ou experiência com Rust;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados geoespaciais no front-end (mapas, geolocalização);
  • Conhecimento sobre os conceitos base da Cloud – containers, VMs e GCP (organização, projetos, regiões, zonas, IAM);
  • Conhecimento dos principais conceitos e funcionalidades como Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, etc;
  • Conhecimento em Terraform.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado (PJ);
  • Benefício flexível por meio do cartão Swile;
  • Gympass;
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde;
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto.

  • Contribuir com revisões de código, design de sistemas, arquitetura e iniciativas de refatoração estratégica;
  • Colaborar com áreas de produto e negócios para traduzir necessidades em soluções técnicas viáveis;
  • Garantir excelência na experiência do usuário e performance front-end;
  • Conduzir iniciativas de inovação tecnológica, incluindo POCs e adoção de novas ferramentas ou paradigmas.


Competências:

  • Experiência com stacks como: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Node.js (NestJS), PostgreSQL..
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes altamente regulados ou em fintechs / agtechs / software as a service (saas);
  • Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas ou iniciativas open source;
  • Antifragilidade, pronto para desbravar entregas críticas para o sucesso do negócio;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e design de arquitetura de serviços e dados;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenharia;
  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (4+ anos), com histórico de impacto técnico significativo;
  • Experiência com Angular e desenvolvimento de SPAs (Single Page Applications);
  • Experiência com APIs REST;
  • Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP), automação de infraestrutura (IaC), CI/CD e observabilidade;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL) e não relacionais em alta escala;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e não técnicas.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento ou experiência com Rust;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados geoespaciais no front-end (mapas, geolocalização);
  • Conhecimento sobre os conceitos base da Cloud – containers, VMs e GCP (organização, projetos, regiões, zonas, IAM);
  • Conhecimento dos principais conceitos e funcionalidades como Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, etc;
  • Conhecimento em Terraform.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado (PJ);
  • Benefício flexível por meio do cartão Swile;
  • Gympass;
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde;
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto;
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto.

title: Node Developer - Remote
description:

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Customer Service Rep (Remote)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Schedule: Full-Time

Industry: U.S. Auto & Home Insurance

Compensation: $800–$1,000 USD/month + Performance Incentives


About the Role

Elite Virtual Assistance (EVA) is hiring Customer Service Representatives in Brazil to support a fast-growing U.S. insurance agency specializing in car and home insurance .

This is an inbound-focused role where you’ll speak with customers, solve problems with empathy, and create an exceptional experience that encourages them to leave a positive Google review . Customers can sometimes be challenging, so we need someone patient, professional, and confident on the phone.

You’ll be joining an already successful team of 20+ people on this account, with an amazing work culture, strong support, and a clear path for growth and promotion .


Key Responsibilities:
  • Answer inbound calls from U.S. customers regarding auto and home insurance
  • Provide high-quality service with empathy, professionalism, and accuracy
  • Convert challenging situations into positive experiences
  • Encourage and earn Google reviews by delivering exceptional service
  • Document every interaction clearly and accurately in the CRM
  • Follow account processes with zero errors — detail orientation is essential


Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Advanced English fluency — written and spoken
  • Strong customer service experience (call center or U.S. accounts preferred)
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to stay calm and professional with difficult callers
  • Highly organized , detail-oriented , and strong with documentation
  • Reliable internet and professional remote workspace


Why Work With EVA:
  • Competitive compensation $800–$1,000 USD/month
  • Monthly performance incentives
  • Join a high-performing, established team with great culture
  • Clear opportunities for career growth and promotions
  • Consistent support, training, and coaching
  • Work with a company that values excellence, growth, and long-term success

title: Analista de Testes Automatizados PL. ( Java, Rest Assured, Selenium, Appium)
description:
Visão Geral:

A Tivit Alma Viva é uma multinacional brasileira e one-stop-shop de tecnologia, presente no mercado há 20 anos e com operação em dez países da América Latina. Por meio de quatro unidades de negócios: Digital Business, Cloud Solutions, CyberSecurity e Technology Platforms, a empresa oferece respostas personalizadas e soluções que impactam nos negócios, e na rotina de empresas e pessoas.

Posição: Analista de Testes Automatizados PL.

Modelo: Remoto

Contrato: CLT


Buscamos um(a) Quality Engineer Pleno para atuar em projetos estratégicos, garantindo a qualidade das entregas com uma visão sistêmica, foco em melhoria contínua e práticas modernas de engenharia. Você fará parte de um time multidisciplinar, colaborando diretamente com áreas de tecnologia e produto para assegurar soluções robustas, confiáveis e orientadas à excelência.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Analisar requisitos técnicos e funcionais, propondo estratégias de validação alinhadas ao contexto do produto.
  • Planejar e executar testes em múltiplos níveis: unitários, integrados, sistema e aceitação.
  • Realizar testes funcionais, exploratórios e automatizados em plataformas Web e Mobile.
  • Documentar evidências, resultados e defeitos de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Reportar, monitorar e garantir o ciclo de vida de bugs em ferramentas de gestão de defeitos.
  • Atuar em conjunto com times multidisciplinares para garantir entregas de alta qualidade.
  • Integrar testes automatizados em pipelines CI/CD (GitLab), analisando logs e realizando troubleshooting.
  • Contribuir na evolução de frameworks, padrões e processos internos de QA.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis e propor melhorias contínuas nas práticas de teste.
  • Zelar pela aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software e cultura de qualidade.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ensino Superior Completo.
  • Experiência em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Definição de estratégias de teste em diferentes níveis (unitário, integrado, sistema e aceitação).
  • Experiência prática com consultas SQL e procedures (PL/SQL).
  • Experiência com Oracle e MongoDB
  • Domínio de ferramentas para testes de API: Postman ou Insomnia.
  • Atuação em testes Web e Mobile (Android/iOS).
  • Experiência em Java 11+ para automação.


  • Experiência comprovada com frameworks e ferramentas:
  • JUnit/TestNG,
  • Jira / Zephyr
  • Rest Assured,
  • Selenium / Cypress,
  • Appium,
  • BrowserStack.
  • Execução e acompanhamento de testes em CI/CD (GitLab).
  • Experiência com versionamento, code review e design patterns.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e práticas de Agile Testing.
  • Experiência em melhorias de ferramentas e processos de QA.


Informações adicionais


O que oferecemos para você?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência médica e Odontológica;
  • Convênio Farmácia (descontos na compra de medicamentos);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TIVIT Club (descontos e parcerias com as melhores lojas);
  • PAC - Programa de aceleração de carreira;
  • Reembolso para certificações;
  • MOBIFLIX – Nossa academia corporativa tem cursos presenciais e online, alinhados as novas tendências do mercado de tecnologia;
  • Plataforma online de crédito consignado, a TIVIT te ajuda a realizar os seus objetivos pessoais como reforma no seu apê/casa, financiar estudos e quitar dívidas, de acordo com as regras e políticas da cia;
  • Programa de Apoio Pessoal com orientação psicológica, financeira e jurídica em parceria com a Alelo.



Acreditamos que o presente é plural e a inclusão transforma, por isso, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas em nossas vagas, para promovermos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, de respeito, justiça e equidade.

Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. - Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Experience in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong experience with version control.

- Strong experience with Unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage.

- Advanced English proficiency.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Corporate Architect
description:
A Verity está buscando novos talentos!


Somos uma boutique para modernização e aceleração digital e buscamos Corporate Architect para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Análise de Negócios e Problemas:

  • Identificar e elencar os problemas de negócio (subdomínios) a partir de cenários e requisitos.
  • Estruturar os problemas em subdomínios de negócios relevantes.
  • Identificar as capacidades de negócios de alto nível (top-level) necessárias para suportar a estratégia da empresa.
  • Classificar adequadamente as capacidades, demonstrando compreensão de como elas se relacionam com os objetivos de negócio e os problemas identificados.
  • Extrair e organizar os requisitos a partir de cenários e especificações.
  • Classificar os requisitos (funcionais, não funcionais, de negócio, etc.).
  • Conectar os requisitos com os problemas de negócio e as capacidades identificadas.


Arquitetura e Design:

  • Definir a arquitetura Alvo (TO-BE) que resolve os problemas de negócio e atende aos requisitos.
  • Identificar arquiteturas de transição para uma migração gradual, se necessário.
  • Garantir o alinhamento da arquitetura com os estilos arquiteturais definidos (ex: Microservices).
  • Definir os fluxos de valor relevantes para o negócio, demonstrando como as capacidades e funcionalidades se interligam para gerar valor.
  • Modelar a interoperabilidade entre as funcionalidades, mostrando como os diferentes componentes do sistema se comunicam e trocam informações.
  • Identificar Building Blocks (componentes reutilizáveis) na arquitetura, demonstrando um foco na eficiência e na padronização.
  • Aplicar padrões de decomposição de Microservices (ex: Domain-Driven Design, Bounded Contexts) para garantir a escalabilidade, a manutenibilidade e a independência dos serviços.


Frameworks e Metodologias:

  • Aplicar o TOGAF Architecture Development Method (ADM) no contexto de projetos.
  • Justificar as escolhas de guias, abordagens e frameworks utilizados (ex: TOGAF, ITIL, COBIT).
  • Adaptar os frameworks e metodologias às necessidades específicas de cada projeto, demonstrando flexibilidade e pragmatismo.


Diferenciais :

  • Recomendar soluções baseadas na análise da arquitetura e dos requisitos de negócio.
  • Garantir que os sistemas estejam alinhados com as necessidades reais do negócio, facilitando a evolução e a adaptação a novas demandas (DDD).
  • Aplicar os padrões táticos do DDD no design dos microsserviços e outros componentes do sistema.
  • Evidenciar o conhecimento específico sobre o funcionamento do setor bancário, seus produtos, serviços, regulamentações e desafios.
  • Documentar de forma clara e concisa os processos de negócio, demonstrando um entendimento profundo do funcionamento da empresa.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos com base na nova arquitetura


Requisitos e qualificações:

Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de software em grande escala, preferencialmente no setor bancário ou financeiro.
  • Experiência prática com a definição e implementação de arquiteturas orientadas a microsserviços.
  • Experiência com a utilização de frameworks de arquitetura como TOGAF


Conhecimento Técnico:

  • Profundo conhecimento de princípios de arquitetura de software, design patterns e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a microsserviços.
  • Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Cloud, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML, BPMN).
  • Familiaridade com Domain-Driven Design (DDD), tanto nos padrões estratégicos quanto táticos.
  • Conhecimento do setor bancário, seus produtos, serviços, regulamentações e desafios.


Habilidades:

  • Capacidade de analisar e resolver problemas complexos de negócio, transformando-os em soluções de arquitetura.
  • Habilidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders e garantir o alinhamento da arquitetura com os objetivos de negócio.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e liderar tecnicamente outros membros do time.
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade de antecipar tendências tecnológicas.
  • Excelente capacidade de documentação técnica.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:
Position Overview


The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.


Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.


Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.


Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.


Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.


Qualifications


Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.


Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: Account Manager (Adtech)
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About Us

Orange Storm is a venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA and Barcelona, Spain. We provide an integrated ecosystem—including a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and AI-driven analytics platform—to help publishers and advertisers drive higher revenue and smarter decisions.

Our global, diverse team is our greatest asset. With a culture rooted in trust, ownership, and continuous learning, we empower talent to grow, experiment, and deliver real-world impact. We are proud of our collaborative spirit, agile execution, and commitment to building scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the ever-evolving AdTech landscape.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a high-performing Account Manager to manage and expand relationships with our advertising clients across the APAC region, including direct advertisers and agencies.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end client relationships, ensuring successful campaign delivery, optimization, and KPI achievement.
  • Develop and implement advertising strategies to drive client ROI and campaign performance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (operations, product, tech) to ensure smooth execution and timely issue resolution.
  • Provide clients with regular data analysis, performance reports, and actionable insights.
  • Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Stay informed about APAC advertising market trends and competitive landscape.


Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic, or mobile marketing as an Account Manager or Customer Success Manager.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Mandarin is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of advertising operations, SDKs, attribution platforms like Appsflyer or Adjust, and fraud prevention.
  • Strong project management, client servicing, and communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach to optimization.
  • Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple accounts remotely across time zones.


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Attractive and competitive pay and Performance Bonus + Uncapped Revenue Commission!
  • Annual Leave: 20 working days paid leave per year (pro-rated) + local public holidays
  • Remote Work: Fully remote with reasonable overlap hours; occasional travel budget if needed
  • And many more!


Orange Storm is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity at all levels of the organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these factors.


We truly appreciate the time and effort every candidate puts into applying to Orange Storm. While we carefully review each application, due to the high volume of interest we receive, we’re unfortunately unable to respond to every individual submission. If your profile aligns with the role and we decide to move forward, a member of our team will reach out to you directly. We thank you in advance for your understanding and for considering a career with us.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.
  • Design and build dashboards and reports in Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization tools.
  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


O que buscamos:

  • Forte experiência em C++ e sistemas embutidos/embarcados;
  • Vivência com Linux ;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas embarcados ;
  • Experiência em otimização de performance, consumo e recursos de hardware;
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, etc.);
  • Boas práticas de segurança e qualidade de código;
  • Atuação em metodologias ágeis.


Seu papel será:

Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de firmware — desde a concepção, arquitetura, implementação até os testes — sempre com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade para produtos conectados.


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR + Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Participação prática nos produtos desenvolvidos pela empresa.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


O que buscamos:

  • Forte experiência em C++ e sistemas embutidos/embarcados;
  • Vivência com Linux ;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas embarcados ;
  • Experiência em otimização de performance, consumo e recursos de hardware;
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, etc.);
  • Boas práticas de segurança e qualidade de código;
  • Atuação em metodologias ágeis.


Seu papel será:

Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de firmware — desde a concepção, arquitetura, implementação até os testes — sempre com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade para produtos conectados.


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR + Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Participação prática nos produtos desenvolvidos pela empresa.

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.
  • Design and build dashboards and reports in Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization tools.
  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.
  • Design and build dashboards and reports in Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization tools.
  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.
